title: Ice Age Sahara as origin of Egyptian civilization

tellings.quote: I think if we want to get into the origins of ancient Egyptian civilization, we're going to have to start looking at what the Sahara was doing during the Ice Age.

plain: The roots of ancient Egyptian civilization may lie in the Sahara Desert during the Ice Age, back when the region was very different from today. A researcher named Graham Hancock puts this forward as his own view, without naming a source, saying that anyone looking for Egypt's origins will "have to start looking at what the Sahara was doing during the Ice Age." If he is right, Egypt's beginnings would be much older than usually thought.
